## Checks

- [ ] `build` green (GitHub Actions: unit tests + Light-builder simulation)
- [ ] `signoff/emulator` posted by `mise run ci` (never by hand)
- [ ] Rules-core change? Perft still exact, and the property tests pass
- [ ] New or changed terms are in `CONTEXT.md`; hard-to-reverse decisions have an ADR; rulings cite the decision log
- [ ] Nothing personal in the diff or in PR comments
